name: Otter.ai
tagline: Automated AI meeting assistant for real-time transcription, summaries, and action items.
definition: Otter.ai is an automated meeting transcription and note-taking platform. It connects to Zoom, Google Meet, and Microsoft Teams calendars to automatically join calls, record audio, generate real-time speaker-tagged transcripts, and extract action items.
why_it_matters: Otter popularized autonomous meeting bots in remote and hybrid workplaces, eliminating the need for manual note-taking and enabling team members to stay focused on active call discussions.
workplace_use_cases: Automatically recording and transcribing daily Zoom/Teams team standups
Generating automated meeting summaries and slide captures for absent teammates
Extracting assigned action items and deadlines into team follow-up emails
Searching past meeting transcripts across company sales calls and interviews
how_to_use: Connect your Google or Outlook calendar at otter.ai, grant OtterPilot permission to join upcoming video calls, and review automatically generated transcripts and summaries in your dashboard.
key_features: OtterPilot automated calendar call join for Zoom, Google Meet, Teams
Otter AI Chat for asking questions across past call transcripts
Automated slide capture during presentation screen shares
Real-time live speaker identification and keyword tagging

pricing.free_tier_details: 300 transcription minutes/month (30 mins per call max).

paid_plans.name: Pro
paid_plans.notes: 1,200 transcription minutes/month (90 mins per call), team sharing.

paid_plans.name: Business
paid_plans.notes: 6,000 transcription minutes/month, admin controls, usage analytics.

paid_plans.name: Enterprise
paid_plans.notes: Single Sign-On (SSO), domain capture, custom retention policies.

name: Fireflies.ai
tagline: AI voice assistant for capturing, analyzing, and searching across corporate conversations.
definition: Fireflies.ai is a conversation intelligence platform that records, transcribes, and analyzes team meetings. It connects across call platforms, phone systems, and CRMs, extracting topics, sentiment, speaker talk-time analytics, and automated CRM entries.
why_it_matters: Fireflies goes beyond transcriptions by serving as an analytical engine for sales and leadership teams, measuring talk-to-listen ratios and auto-logging call notes directly into Salesforce or HubSpot.
workplace_use_cases: Logging structured customer meeting notes directly into CRM deal records
Analyzing sales call talk time ratio and objection handling metrics
Creating soundbites and snippets of key customer feedback for product teams
Tracking competitor mentions and pricing objections across all team sales calls
how_to_use: Sign in at fireflies.ai, connect calendar and CRM accounts, invite Fred (the AI bot) to meetings, and access auto-generated intelligence dashboards.
key_features: Fred AI meeting recorder bot for web conferencing and dialers
Customizable AskFred conversational search bot across meeting transcripts
Native integrations with Salesforce, HubSpot, Slack, and Zapier
Topic Tracker and sentiment/analytics dashboard

pricing.free_tier_details: 800 minutes of storage per seat with limited transcription credits.

paid_plans.name: Pro
paid_plans.notes: Unlimited transcription, 8,000 mins storage, AI summaries, smart search filters.

paid_plans.name: Business
paid_plans.notes: Unlimited storage, conversation intelligence, video screen recording, CRM entry.

name: Fathom
tagline: Free AI meeting assistant that records, transcribes, and highlights key call moments.
definition: Fathom is a meeting recording and transcription assistant built for Zoom, Microsoft Teams, and Google Meet. It automatically records calls, generates instant transcripts, and highlights critical call moments for rapid review.
why_it_matters: Fathom won widespread popularity among individuals and small teams by offering robust, high-accuracy meeting transcription with generous free tier features and one-click copy-paste formatting.
workplace_use_cases: Summarizing client discovery calls and highlighting decision points
Copy-pasting bulleted meeting notes into Notion, Asana, or Google Docs
Sharing video clips of customer feedback directly into Slack channels
Auto-syncing call notes with CRM records in HubSpot or Salesforce
how_to_use: Download the Fathom application or web extension, connect your calendar, click 'Record' during video calls, and view instant structured summaries immediately after ending the call.
key_features: Instant summary generation upon ending calls
One-click bookmarking during calls to highlight important moments
Direct sync to CRM platforms (HubSpot, Salesforce, Close)
Multi-language call summary support

pricing.free_tier_details: Free forever for individuals with unlimited recording and transcription.

paid_plans.name: Premium Edition
paid_plans.notes: Advanced AI summary customization, zapier triggers, and enhanced CRM sync.

paid_plans.name: Team Edition
paid_plans.notes: Shared team repository, central billing, deal intelligence dashboard.

name: tl;dv
tagline: AI meeting recorder for Google Meet, Zoom, and Teams with timestamped clip sharing.
definition: tl;dv is a meeting recorder and summary assistant engineered specifically for remote product and sales teams. It transcribes calls in over 30 languages, generates AI summaries, and makes video recordings searchable by timestamped keywords.
why_it_matters: tl;dv focuses heavily on multi-language global teams and video highlight creation, enabling product managers to clip 10-second video quotes of user feedback to share in Slack or Jira tickets.
workplace_use_cases: Creating bite-sized video clip highlights of user research interviews
Searching across 100+ past recorded product meetings for specific feature requests
Auto-summarizing customer support discovery calls into Slack channels
Transcribing international client meetings across 30+ regional languages
how_to_use: Install the Google Meet Chrome extension or Zoom integration at tldv.io, set record preferences, tag timestamps live during calls, and share generated clip URLs.
key_features: Multi-language transcription supporting 30+ languages
Bite-sized video snippet clipping and shareable link generator
AI-driven call topic summarization aligned with custom prompts
Integrations with Notion, Slack, HubSpot, and Salesforce

pricing.free_tier_details: Free unlimited meeting recording and transcription with basic summaries.

paid_plans.name: Pro
paid_plans.notes: Advanced AI meeting reports, auto-download video files, CRM integrations.

paid_plans.name: Enterprise
paid_plans.notes: Custom security policies, dedicated account management, custom data retention.

name: Avoma
tagline: AI meeting assistant and conversation intelligence platform for sales and customer success.
definition: Avoma is an AI meeting assistant that automatically records, transcribes, and summarizes business meetings, analyzing conversation insights for sales and support.
why_it_matters: Avoma unifies pre-meeting scheduling, live note-taking, and post-meeting CRM updates in one platform.
workplace_use_cases: Automatically logging structured call notes into Salesforce and HubSpot
Analyzing sales team talk-to-listen ratios and key topic mentions
Sharing timestamped meeting snippets with product teams
how_to_use: Connect calendar and web conferencing to Avoma, and the AI bot will join scheduled meetings.
key_features: AI Meeting Assistant with automated speaker identification
Revenue Intelligence and deal pipeline tracking
CRM automatic note sync and keyword search

pricing.free_tier_details: Free tier includes basic manual note-taking and call recording.

paid_plans.name: Starter
paid_plans.notes: AI meeting summaries, automated CRM sync.

name: Supernormal
tagline: AI note taker for Google Meet, Zoom, and Teams with customizable meeting templates.
definition: Supernormal is an AI meeting assistant that automatically records, transcribes, and writes structured meeting notes tailored to specific meeting types.
why_it_matters: Supernormal stands out with custom meeting templates designed for 1-on-1s, executive syncs, and candidate interviews.
workplace_use_cases: Capturing structured action items and decision points during executive meetings
Generating standardized interview summaries for candidate hiring loops
Syncing notes into Notion, Slack, and HubSpot
how_to_use: Install the Chrome extension or invite Supernormal bot to your calendar events.
key_features: Customizable meeting templates for different meeting formats
Multi-language transcription in 20+ languages
Direct export to Notion, Slack, and Google Docs

paid_plans.name: Pro
paid_plans.notes: Unlimited meeting notes, custom templates, CRM integration.

name: MeetGeek
tagline: AI meeting assistant that auto-records, transcribes, and shares call insights with team channels.
definition: MeetGeek is an automated meeting recorder and analytics platform that captures video meetings and distributes AI summaries into company tools.
why_it_matters: MeetGeek focuses on automated team knowledge distribution, pushing highlights directly to Slack channels.
workplace_use_cases: Pushing automated meeting summaries to dedicated Slack channels
Tracking team meeting effectiveness metrics and talk-time distribution
Creating searchable meeting repositories for team knowledge bases
how_to_use: Connect your Google/Outlook calendar and web conferencing app to MeetGeek.
key_features: Automated meeting recording, transcription, and summarization
Auto-sharing rules for Slack, Trello, and Notion
Meeting sentiment and engagement analytics

pricing.free_tier_details: 5 hours of transcription/month on the free plan.

name: Read AI
tagline: Meeting analytics and summary assistant that measures participant engagement and sentiment.
definition: Read AI is a meeting productivity assistant that generates transcripts, executive summaries, and real-time engagement and sentiment metrics.
why_it_matters: Read AI stands out by measuring meeting health, participant engagement levels, and sentiment during live video calls.
workplace_use_cases: Measuring meeting effectiveness and team engagement scores
Generating automated multi-meeting weekly digest reports
Generating action item checklists post-call
how_to_use: Connect your calendar at read.ai and invite Read AI to video calls.
key_features: Meeting engagement and sentiment score dashboards
Automated meeting summaries and action items
Read Chief of Staff multi-meeting weekly report synthesis

paid_plans.name: Pro
paid_plans.notes: Unlimited meeting reports, custom meeting templates.

name: Krisp
tagline: AI noise-cancellation app that removes background noise, echo, and generates meeting notes.
definition: Krisp is an AI desktop application that removes background noise, room echo, and voices from microphone and speaker audio during live calls, while auto-generating meeting notes.
why_it_matters: Krisp is the gold standard for real-time background noise cancellation, allowing remote workers to take calls in noisy cafes or home environments.
workplace_use_cases: Canceling barking dogs, construction, and cafe noise during live Zoom calls
Removing room acoustic echo from microphone audio
Generating automated meeting transcripts and summaries
how_to_use: Download Krisp on macOS/Windows, select Krisp Microphone/Speaker in Zoom/Teams, and toggle noise cancellation.
key_features: Real-time bi-directional AI noise and echo cancellation
Automatic meeting recording and transcription
Works with all video conferencing apps (Zoom, Teams, Meet)

pricing.free_tier_details: Free tier includes 60 minutes/day of noise cancellation.

paid_plans.name: Pro
paid_plans.notes: Unlimited noise cancellation, unlimited meeting notes, central billing.
